remaining_tasks.name: Model stop-loss at prev_close — rerun EV at 0.75×ATR

decisions.rationale: Triples trade frequency (14→37 unique days/yr) while keeping 93.3% EOD win rate; breakeven WR is 95.3% — only 2% gap, likely closable with stop loss

decisions.decision: Stop loss at prev_close as Phase 2 first test
decisions.rationale: Current model has no stop — losing trades cost 92.4% of spread width; a stop at the short strike level would limit losses to ~credit+slippage, potentially turning 0.75×ATR positive EV

decisions.decision: EOD hold as alternative exit to 60% PT
decisions.rationale: 97.5% win rate at 1.0×ATR means holding to 4pm captures full credit on almost all trades; 60% PT leaves money on the table

next_action: Add stop-loss-at-prev_close to Strategy A backtest and rerun EV at each ATR threshold — then build VIX regime × alignment stratification table
context_notes: Phase 1 complete. The core finding is solid (97.5% EOD safety) but the simple credit spread structure barely exploits it. The key insight discovered this session: breakeven win rate rises as credit/width falls, so lowering ATR threshold hurts EV despite raising trade frequency. Phase 2 needs two levers: (1) stop loss to cap losing trade costs, (2) secondary filters to identify high-conviction subset where actual win rate exceeds the breakeven threshold.
